svg.title: Heading ablation — frozen trace only
svg.desc: Four arms, two groups, sixty-four station records; stored measurements, raw flags, deltas, arguments, headings and prediction. No source pixels and no scientific recomputation.
svg.text: Source pin counts: before=13, afterImport=13, after=13; full path/hash manifests in SVG metadata and hash-bound JSON.
Input pin counts: before=5, after=5; canonical verified=true; source path refs appear in full metadata.
All 64 station IDs are retained in metadata and per-row title/data attributes. Full raw native answers remain in the hash-bound input.
No pixels/background. Stored origins are printed verbatim; heading arrows use SVG rotation only. Luminosity/delta charts use display-only scaling.
